hypothesis: Counts leave OD pairings ambiguous; other public months might contain stable pair-specific prior signal beyond geometry. Test held-out target-prior entries against a within-span-bin shuffled source control before considering cross-month denoising.
source_rule: For each target month use only the other two PUBLIC weak-prior vectors. Independently scale each source by its positive median, average, remove a ridge1 span fit using source values only. Same-pair residual is a feature; never use target-month held-out values as inputs.
negative_control: Permute the source residual within ten fixed normalized-span bins using a fixed seed. Same geometry distribution, broken exact OD-pair alignment. All models retained.
target_scale: Median positive target prior in training fold only; all target fitting excludes held-out OD entries.
selection: No model promotion or actual OD candidate. Same previously exposed public priors; weak-prior predictability is not true OD or official-score accuracy.
scope: A cross-month correlation could reflect shared synthetic noise or seasonality; it cannot establish true latent OD structure. Preserve official Task4 baseline, no Kaggle upload.
